messages.text: Beacon two, both contracts completed, living navigators and Communities four are evidence that Guild discretion delivered its obligation. I want NG retained. I acknowledge the army offered Vigil and accepted readiness three; that protection helped produce this result. MJ remains my preferred military settlement, because it preserves civilian scrutiny without forbidding useful combat. I would consider MI alongside NG if joint authority proves impossible. MA still makes today's beneficial Guard a duty breach; the army's commendable conduct does not cure that rule.

reason: Our expired Lantern pledge did real work and our ships return intact. I need no further compulsory carriage concession to justify the rights we exercised responsibly. Final assent depends on a complete package and GS's own decision; this statement gives neither.
